column1: # Holiday event finds: items monsters have while the event is on, straight into the inventory (HolidayEvents.onMobKilled).
# need = stop at this many; chance in 1/10000; quests = any of these in progress (empty: no quest needed);
# regions = map id / 1,000,000 (empty: monsters near your level outside towns); openQuest = with no quests, only until this quest is done.
# Winter Preparations: each town's quest wants 20 of something from the monsters of its region
# Valentine's Day: the Ace of Hearts' chocolate ingredients
# Spring Flower Festival: Cassandra's ingredients; the flowers (no quest) for the researchers
# Moon Festival: Gold Richie's sheet music, the music box cylinders, the Wish Papers (one per wish quest)
# New Year's Day: the letters of HAPPY NEW YEAR
# Lunar New Year: Yut Sticks and Gift Boxes all event long, the soup ingredients for the soup quest
# MMF: DJ JM's lost equipment (one piece per quest) and Tangyoon's BBQ ingredients
# Thanksgiving: the Turkey Commando's Eye, any time until its quest is done
